game.name: Def Jam Rapstar (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt)
game.desc: Def Jam Rapstar is a rhythm game for Xbox 360. The title allows you to sing hip-hop alone or in pairs, with tracks such as My Humps by the Black Eyed Peas, Wild Thang by 2 Much, Mrs. Officer by Lil Wayne or Lean Wit It, Rock Wit It by the group Dem Franchise Boyz. It is also possible to create your own clips with the help of a very complete editor.
